description: In front of you on the bed are a gray tray filled with small clear ice cubes, a yellow cup, and a purple scoop. The right hand picks up the purple scoop from the right and dips it into the gray tray to gather ice, while the left hand steadies the tray; then the left hand lifts and angles the yellow cup under the scoop as the right hand tilts the scoop to dump several ice cubes into the cup before pulling the scoop back.
